programme.desc: S1 E9 — Unfriendly Skies The death of a first-class passenger on a flight to Las Vegas has Grissom and his team scrambling to examine the physical evidence and get testimony from the other passengers.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E10 — Sex, Lies and Larvae The death of a woman on a remote mountain trail perplexes Grissom and Sara (William Petersen, Jorja Fox), while Catherine and Warrick (Marg Helgenberger, Gary Dourdan) try to piece together the artful theft of a multimillionaire's (guest star John Getz) painting.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E11 — I-15 Murders Grissom and Willows hunt down the Highway I-15 serial killer; Sidel and Brown are assigned to solve a robbery and murder.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E12 — Fahrenheit 932 Grissom is called to help a man on death row who is trying to clear his name; Catherine and Nick investigate the execution-style murder of a teenager.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E13 — Boom Grissom, Sara and Warrick investigate the bombing of a Las Vegas office building; Nick is the prime suspect in the murder of a sex worker.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E14 — To Halve and to Hold Grissom and Catherine search for human remains in the desert; Warrick and Sara investigate the king of a stripper-for-hire outfit.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E15 — Table Stakes When a woman's body is discovered in a missing showgirl's swimming pool, the team believes they've got a double murder on their hands.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E16 — Too Tough to Die The CSI team investigates a sexual assault; Catherine and Warrick help the district attorney with a murder case.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E17 — Face Lift While investigating a homicide with Catherine (Marg Helgenberger), a shocked Gil (William Petersen) discovers that a prime suspect has been missing for decades; Warrick and Sara (Gary Dourdan, Jorja Fox) try to explain what seems like a physical impossibility.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E18 — $35K O.B.O The team visits the site of a fatal carjacking and realises heavy rainfall washed away much of the evidence.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E19 — Gentle, Gentle A difficult case involving the possible kidnapping of an infant forces the team to examine evidence that points to an unthinkable conclusion.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E20 — Sounds of Silence The team looks into a vehicular fatality involving a deaf man; Catherine and Nick investigate a multiple homicide.
programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

Based in a community of around 10,000 people, Buckie teammates Vicki and Elaine often encounter friends and acquaintances on their ambulance shifts. programme.desc: S7 E7 — Episode 7 Paul and Nicole of the Special Operations Response Team are called after a mobility scooter plunges down a steep embankment. The crew work closely with fire and rescue to lower a paramedic down by rope to administer vital pain relief to the patient. Thoughts then turn to how the emergency services can get the patient to safety. In Edinburgh, teammates Kevin and Martyn respond to a 999 call from a concerned member of the public after a man is found unconscious in the city centre. They arrive to find that the patient is a familiar face - a homeless man with an alcohol dependency, and who is a frequent user of the ambulance service. Not long after taking this unfortunate patient to hospital, the team receive another 999 call - the same man has been found passed out in the street, having absconded from A&E. The crew now face the dilemma of how to best treat this struggling person.
programme.title: Paramedics On Scene

programme.desc: S21 E18 — The Caves of Androzani: Part 2 Military captive Salateen tells Peri and the Doctor they are dying from spectrox tomaemia and the only cure is the milk of the queen bat, who sleeps deep below the caverns.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E22 — The Twin Dilemma: Part 2 On Jaconda, Mestor’s cruel domination over the planet's population continues while on Titan Three, the Doctor seems to have been blown up in a booby-trapped building.

programme.desc: S21 E24 — The Twin Dilemma: Part 4 Mestor’s true plan is revealed and the Doctor's old Gallifreyan friend Azmael comes to the realisation that he has been corrupted long enough by the Gastropod leader.

programme.desc: S26 E11 — The Curse of Fenric: Part 4 The Ancient Haemovore stands upon the Earth once again, determined to change the future by erasing the past and Ace finally feels love for her mother.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E12 — Survival: Part 1 Trying to work out why people have been disappearing from Perivale, Ace is cornered by a Cheetah-Person on a horse called Kara, who transports her to a far-off planet.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E13 — Survival: Part 2 The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People’s world, where the Master lies in wait. He cannot leave without the Doctor's assistance.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S17 E21 — Shada The 2017 animated reconstruction of the unaired serial. On the planet Shada, the Time Lords have built a prison for the Universe's most dangerous criminals.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E2 — Battlefield: Part 2 The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur’s spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern, while Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart arrives in Carbury where he encounters Morgaine.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E3 — Battlefield: Part 3 Furious at her inability to find and engage Arthur in battle, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer upon the planet unless the Doctor gives her what she wants.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E4 — Battlefield: Part 4 The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's nuclear warhead and prepares to start a countdown that will destroy Earth forever.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E5 — Ghost Light: Part 1 The Doctor and Ace explore Victorian house Gabriel Chase and realise it hides just as many dark secrets in its Drawing Room as it does in the dark cellar.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E6 — Ghost Light: Part 2 The Doctor and Scotland Yard’s finest, Inspector Mackenzie, attempt to question Josiah Smith while both Light and Control emerge from their respective slumbers.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E7 — Ghost Light: Part 3 Only Redvers, still searching for the elusve Saxe-Coburg, seems to be able to withstand Light and communicate with Control and Ace realises her past actions need to be dealt with.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E8 — The Curse of Fenric: Part 1 As Russian forces approach the English coastline, an ancient evil stirs beneath the surface of the water. For Ace and the Doctor, a deadly game of revenge has begun.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S26 E9 — The Curse of Fenric: Part 2 The Viking runes in the crypt contain a secret to Ace’s past, while Millington and Judson’s Ultima machine offers to break the chains of the Wolves of Fenric.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
